title: Emitters and hook points
summary: Which emitter of chock compile writes each hook point, and the file chock sync installs for it.
intro: A hook point is where a compiled control runs. The chock compile command hands each policy to one emitter per hook point. Then chock sync installs what the emitters wrote. Each arrow out of chock compile names the hook points that emitter writes, as the engine's compiler maps them.

boundaries.label: What runs it: chock sync and chock gateway run

nodes.label: chock compile
nodes.card: Runs the emitter for each hook point on a policy, in the engine's order, and writes the output to `.chock/compiled/<id>/<surface>/`. The gateway hook point has no emitter. It is modeled for budgets and egress, and nothing is emitted for it.

nodes.label: Git hook emitter
nodes.card: Emits git-hook entrypoints from the policy's implementations folder: guards at pre-commit, pre-merge-commit and pre-push. Hard at commit and push. `git commit --no-verify` skips it.

nodes.label: CI emitter
nodes.card: Emits a CI gate step that re-runs the policy's check over a pull request's commit range: the backstop for a skipped git hook.

nodes.label: In-agent emitter
nodes.card: Hook fragments for every wired vendor. The `pre-tool-use` hook point refuses a call before it runs. The `stop` hook point reads what the turn left in the worktree and earns no coverage word. The `agent-hooks` hook point is the same deny for Copilot CLI and VS Code agent mode.

nodes.label: Managed settings
nodes.card: Emits Claude managed-settings.json fragments. There is no installer, so it enforces nothing today.

nodes.label: Ambient rule
nodes.card: Emits the AGENTS.md block the agent is asked to follow. Advisory: it blocks nothing on its own.

nodes.label: MCP gateway
nodes.card: Emits the gate specs the MCP proxy evaluates per tool call. It governs MCP-routed tool calls only.

nodes.label: Git hooks
nodes.card: The chock sync command installs a dispatcher in .git/hooks. It runs every executable script for the event.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.card: With --ci, chock sync writes .github/workflows/chock.yml. Until then ci-gate is compiled and inert, and the coverage report says so.

nodes.label: Agent hook files
nodes.card: The chock sync command writes each wired agent's hook file, in that agent's own format. What happens when a hook cannot run is agentseam's data, listed below.

nodes.label: INDEX.md
nodes.card: The chock sync command compiles every active rule into .agents/policies/INDEX.md. AGENTS.md holds one pointer to it.

nodes.label: Gateway proxy
nodes.card: A stdio proxy the client launches instead of the real MCP server. It refuses matching `tools/call` payloads. One downstream server per gateway process.
